# Divine Homam

> Traditional homam and pooja ceremony requests across Tamil Nadu, India.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.divinehomam.com/): Ceremony catalog, booking request, and service information.

## Ceremony guides
- [Sri Maha Ganapathi Homam](https://www.divinehomam.com/puja/sri-maha-ganapathi-homam): Removes all obstacles and invokes auspicious beginnings for ventures, weddings, business inaugurations, and new residences.
- [Gruhapravesam & Vastu Homam](https://www.divinehomam.com/puja/gruhapravesam-vastu-homam): A comprehensive purification ceremony for new apartments and homes, including Go Pooja, Ganapathi, Navagraha, and Vastu Shanthi.
- [Navagraha Shanti Homam](https://www.divinehomam.com/puja/navagraha-shanti-homam): A homam dedicated to the nine celestial bodies, traditionally requested for Sade Sati and Rahu-Ketu doshams, and for health, harmony, and career growth.
- [Sri Ayushya Homam](https://www.divinehomam.com/puja/sri-ayushya-homam): Conducted for first birthdays or the birthdays of elders, with prayers for longevity (Ayur Vriddhi), vital energy, and protection from severe illnesses.
- [Sri Satyanarayana Swamy Vratham](https://www.divinehomam.com/puja/sri-satyanarayana-swamy-vratham): Performed on full-moon days or special occasions to invite Mahavishnu's blessings, domestic harmony, and career breakthroughs.
- [Sashtiapthapoorthi (60th) & Bheemaratha Shanthi](https://www.divinehomam.com/puja/sashtiapthapoorthi-bheemaratha-shanthi): A Vedic marriage renewal and rejuvenation ceremony marking the completion of 60 years, with Kalasa abhishekam using consecrated waters.
- [Kala Sarpa Dosha Shanti Homam](https://www.divinehomam.com/puja/kala-sarpa-dosha-shanti-homam): A homam dedicated to Kala Sarpa Dosha, traditionally performed to ease fear and confusion, clear obstacles in work and business, and support family harmony.
- [Dhanvantari Homam](https://www.divinehomam.com/puja/dhanvantari-homam): A homam to Lord Dhanvantari, the divine physician, performed to seek relief from illness, support recovery, and pray for good health and a long life.
- [Narayana Pooja](https://www.divinehomam.com/puja/narayana-pooja): A devotional worship of Lord Narayana with prayers, offerings, and the recitation of sacred names and mantras, seeking peace, prosperity, and well-being.
- [Temple Balalayam and Kumbhabhishekam](https://www.divinehomam.com/puja/temple-balalayam-kumbhabhishekam): Temple consecration rituals performed to renew and sanctify a temple, with the divine presence ritually invoked, transferred, and ceremonially reinstalled after renovation.
- [48-Day Temple Mandala Abhishekam](https://www.divinehomam.com/puja/temple-mandala-abhishekam-48-days): A series of sacred bathing rituals performed at a temple over a traditional 48-day mandala period, with offerings and abhishekam made to the deity with prayers.
